This is the Class of 2027 hub. Here is how it works.

Events, deadlines, photos, and senior news in one place, run by students for students.

Posted Sep 27, 2026, 7:00 AM · Updated Nov 6, 2026, 10:49 AM

Welcome, Bulldogs. This site is built and run by members of the Class of 2027 so the whole class has one place to look.

What you will find

  • Events with dates, campus, and add-to-calendar links
  • Announcements sorted by category so the important ones do not get buried
  • The Gallery, filled by you. Submit photos from any event
  • Senior Resources for graduation requirements, FAFSA, transcripts, and more

One honest note

This is a student-run site. Anything official comes from Waukegan High School and District 60. When we are unsure about a date, we say so instead of guessing.
